articles.description: The Chicago Cubs are currently ripping up sidewalks outside Wrigley Field for security updates in conjunction with the planned 2027 All-Star Game.
articles.title: Column: While the Chicago Cubs watch the World Series on TV, security upgrades are underway at Wrigley Field

articles.description: 2019: The Chicago Cubs hired veteran catcher and 2016 World Series team member David Ross as their manager.
articles.title: Today in Chicago History: Cubs hire ‘Grandpa Rossy’ David Ross as their manager

articles.description: The Milwaukee Brewers in the World Series is an unfortunate turn of events for almost everyone except real baseball fans.
articles.title: Column: Milwaukee Brewers making World Series is unfortunate for Chicago Cubs — but great for baseball fans

articles.description: The Baltimore Orioles have hired Jared Banner as general manager. He was the assistant GM of the Chicago Cubs, taking on that role in 2024.
articles.title: Jared Banner leaves Chicago Cubs to be general manager of Baltimore Orioles

articles.description: The Chicago Cubs, who had MLB’s best team defense, have five Gold Glove Award finalists. Chicago White Sox second baseman Chase Meidroth also is a finalist.
articles.title: Gold Glove Award finalists are announced, including 5 Cubs and 1 White Sox player
